feeds.title: meetNKY Blog
feeds.description: Learn about local places to eat, boutique hotels, the bourbon gateway and B-Line bourbon experience and more on our meetNKY blog. meetNKY is your guide to where to stay, fun things to do, and places to eat in Florence, Covington, Newport, Kentucky, as well as the Cincinnati region.

feeds.title: Kentucky Lake Blog
feeds.description: We've compiled a list of things you can't miss at Kentucky Lake! From events, places and activities your vacation will be full of adventure, with a side of relaxation.

feeds.title: See Somerset Blog
feeds.description: Our blog shares the latest news, events, travel tips, and updates from Somerset Tourism. Read on and you'll see Somerset, the spirit of southern Kentucky. Somerset, the spirit of southern Kentucky!

feeds.title: Kentucky Travels
feeds.description: Hi, I am Jim, I love Kentucky, and traveling in and around Kentucky! I also love the entire country and all of the beautiful and strange places here and there! This blog covers the overlooked, forgotten, and underrated places, people, and moments in history in America, with a focus on Kentucky! It will cover great tourist stops, books about people and history, and include photos and postcard scans.

feeds.title: Where I've Been » Travels
feeds.description: I'm Candy and I'll share where I've been and what I've learned along the way. My job as a software consultant involves lots of travel and I've learned what to do and not to do when traveling. I hope to inspire you with pretty pictures and give you practical advice that will give you the confidence to see the world whether it be near or far!

feeds.title: The Travel Authority Blog
feeds.description: The Travel Authority is the largest American Express Travel Representative in the United States and offers a full array of services including vacation travel stores, corporate travel management, online travel, meeting and incentives, and 24/7/365 travel support center.

feeds.title: A Southern Drawl » Travel
feeds.description: I'm Grace White! A 27-year-old, currently residing in Louisville, Kentucky with my hubby, Jordan (aka 'J'), and our pup, Jeter. At Southern Drawl, you can expect a daily dose of inspiration with outfits, health & wellness tips, travel guides, and more.

feeds.title: The Kentucky Gent » Travel
feeds.description: This section features articles on Travel by The Kentucky Gent. Josh started The Kentucky Gent as a way for me to show that Southern boys have style too. A born and breaded Kentuckian josh shares authentic experiences in hopes to inspire other and create.

feeds.title: Visit Frankfort
feeds.description: Frankfort Tourism promotes the capital city's rich history, outdoor adventures, waterfront fun, bourbon & candy tours, a hip art-scene & vibrant downtown.

feeds.title: Paducah Blog
feeds.description: Creativity. Inspiration. Heritage. Find your inspiration in Paducah, Kentucky! Browse upcoming festivals and events, things to do, tours, maps and local guide.
